## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what changed and why.

## Task and contract impact

Link local task and optional real Jira; identify API/shared/ERD/migration impact.

## Verification

List actual commands/results and scenarios; link evidence. Mark prerequisites blocked explicitly.

## Screenshots

Include relevant UI evidence without secrets/private data.

## Checklist

- [ ] Local checks pass; failures/blockers explained.
- [ ] Acceptance and meaningful failure scenarios verified.
- [ ] Server/DB authorization checked where applicable.
- [ ] Contract/shared/ERD/migrations/types aligned.
- [ ] Documentation outside report/ is English.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, dependencies, or builds committed.
- [ ] Reviewer approval before merge.

CI/CD and staging are disabled during foundation.
